Subject: Pilot roadmap: goals and close window for Lumina Health

Hi Emma,

It was great to meet yesterday — thanks again for sharing the pilot goals. I wanted to put a simple starter roadmap in writing so we have a shared view of scope, owners, and the target close window. I attached a one-page MAP worksheet (MAP-worksheet.xlsx) with suggested milestones. High-level ask: confirm 3 things so we can finalize the mutual action plan and lock a pilot start date by Nov 23.

1) Primary pilot objective: reduce triage latency by 40% (is that right?)
2) Stakeholder owners: Emma (champion), Sarah (procurement), Compliance lead (TBD)
3) Target close/purchase window: 60 days from today (Dec 8) — ping me if you need a longer cadence.

Proposed next step: 30-minute sync to walk the worksheet and assign owners. I have these slots open:
- Tue Nov 9, 10:00–10:30 PT
- Tue Nov 9, 15:00–15:30 PT
- Wed Nov 10, 11:00–11:30 PT

Agenda I anticipate: 1) confirm pilot success metrics, 2) confirm roles and procurement timeline, 3) identify compliance evidence needed for SOC2/data residency.

Marissa will be your CSM and will join the session to map onboarding steps. Jonas is included for commercial questions only.

Attaching: MAP-worksheet.xlsx and a draft SOW for reference.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

Best,
Karthik Iyer

Subject: Re: Pilot roadmap: goals and close window for Lumina Health

Thanks Karthik — this is helpful. Quick answers:

1) Yes, the 40% triage latency reduction is the success metric the product team cares about. We can also accept a 30% floor if tradeoffs pop up.
2) Owners: I will be the champion and lead product validation. Sarah is our procurement lead and will manage the contract. For compliance, please loop in our security lead, Jamal Patel (jamal.patel@luminahealth.com) — he will need SOC2 evidence and network topology notes.
3) The timeline target of Dec 8 is aggressive but doable provided we can get procurement and compliance questions answered quickly.

I can take Tue Nov 9 at 10:00 PT. Please send a calendar invite. Also please add a high-level checklist of what evidence Jamal will need so I can prep him.
